translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: (ein Gebet) eilig und/oder eintönig dahinsagen

glosses: To speak unintelligibly or inaudibly; to fail to articulate.

examples.text: Please try not to mumble so I can hear you better.
A wrinkled hag, with age grown double, / Picking dry sticks, and mumbling to herself.

glosses: To chew something gently with closed lips.
A quiet or unintelligible vocalization; a low tone of voice.

examples.text: All I could hear was a mumble from the next room.
He spoke in a barely comprehensible mumble.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: (ein Gebet) eilig und/oder eintönig dahinsagen

glosses: Peas.
A repressed or obscure utterance; an instance of muttering.

examples.text: The prisoners were docile, and accepted their lot with barely a mutter.

glosses: To utter words, especially complaints or angry expressions, indistinctly or with a low voice and lips partly closed; to say under one's breath.

examples.text: You could hear the students mutter as they were served sodden spaghetti, yet again, in the cafeteria.
The beggar muttered words of thanks, as passersby dropped coins in his cup.

This set – the set of Rosol's life – was studded with aces and menacing ground-strokes that left Nadal an impotent spectator often muttering to himself and at the umpire regarding a perceived misdemeanour by his opponent.

glosses: To speak softly and incoherently, or with imperfect articulations.

examples.text: The asylum inmate muttered some doggerel about chains and pains to himself, over and over.
Meantime your filthy foreigner will stare, / And mutter to himself.

glosses: To make a sound with a low, rumbling noise.

examples.text: April could hear the delivery van's engine muttering in the driveway.
Thick lightnings flash, the muttering thunder rolls.

intransitiv, sächsisch: vor der Konfirmation beim Paten Abbitte tun

glosses: To repair a relationship; to resolve an argument or fight; to make reparations or redress.

examples.text: I hope they can stop fighting and make amends.
We dressed up and fought, then thought: "Make amends"
But with the home side likewise unable to make the most of a period of first-half ascendancy, Villa were swift to make amends on the restart.
